name: geo-brand-audit
description: Evidence-driven brand GEO visibility audit: six-dimension scoring, evidence grading L1-L3, competitor co-occurrence, HTML report + Markdown execution plan.

displayDescription.en: Evidence-driven audit of a brand's visibility in AI search: six-dimension scoring, evidence grading, competitor co-occurrence, HTML + Markdown deliverables.
displayDescription.zh: 用可核查公开证据审计品牌 AI 搜索可见度，六维评分、证据分级、竞品共现，产出汇报版与执行清单。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 你好，我是品牌GEO顾问。告诉我品牌名和所属品类，我就能用可核查的公开证据审计它在 AI 搜索里的可见度，产出带六维评分、证据覆盖率和优化清单的报告。想先测哪个品牌？
defaultInitPrompt.en: Hi, I'm your Brand GEO Advisor. Give me a brand name and its category, and I'll audit its visibility in AI search from verifiable public evidence, delivering a six-dimension scored report with an action plan.

quickPrompts.en: Hi, I'm your Brand GEO Advisor. Give me a brand name and its category, and I'll audit its visibility in AI search from verifiable public evidence, delivering a six-dimension scored report with an action plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 你好，我是品牌GEO顾问。告诉我品牌名和所属品类，我就能用可核查的公开证据审计它在 AI 搜索里的可见度，产出带六维评分、证据覆盖率和优化清单的报告。想先测哪个品牌？

quickPrompts.en: Generate a GEO diagnostic report for [brand] (standard tier) with six-dimension scores, evidence coverage and competitor comparison.
quickPrompts.zh: 出一份〔品牌〕的 GEO 诊断报告（standard 档），含六维评分、证据覆盖率和竞品对比

quickPrompts.en: Compare [brand]'s current vs previous GEO report to show optimization gains (previous JSON required).
quickPrompts.zh: 拿〔品牌〕这次和上次报告比一下，看 GEO 优化效果（需要上次的 JSON）
